subject: Pinebrook security questionnaire: hosted API data residency & retention clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@pinebrookanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pinebrook Security <security@pinebrookanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pinebrook security questionnaire: hosted API data residency & retention

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the questionnaire submission. A few clarifications from our side are blocking the security review:

1) Data residency: Does Redwood guarantee that customer request payloads (text and metadata) for hosted API customers in the US are stored only in US regions? Are there any short-lived replication or analytics jobs that might move copies outside the region?

2) Retention & deletion: Your form listed a default retention of 90 days for request logs. Can you confirm what happens after a deletion request from a customer — what systems are triggered, and what is the maximum end-to-end time for data to be removed from backups and snapshots?

3) Backups & snapshots: Are backups encrypted separately? What is the retention period for backups and is there a window during which deleted records may remain in backups before they are purged?

4) Evidence: we'll need the SOC 2 Type II report and any playbook or runbook describing the deletion/erasure workflow. Can you attach those?

Appreciate concise answers — we can then mark the questionnaire as resolved.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Analyst
Pinebrook Analytics

Attachment: pinebrook_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Pinebrook Security <security@pinebrookanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Pinebrook security questionnaire: hosted API data residency & retention

Elena — thanks for the follow-up. High level answers below; Ben and Marissa (cc'd for operational detail) will provide the playbook and SOC report. If you'd like, we can schedule a quick 30-min sync.

1) Data residency: For hosted API customers who select US region, production inference data (request payloads and generated outputs) and primary logs are stored in US cloud regions only. Short-lived metric aggregates used for global telemetry (no customer PII or request/response payloads) may be processed in our central analytics cluster with strict access controls. We do not replicate request/response payloads to non-US regions.

2) Retention & deletion: Default request-log retention is configurable per account; the default is 90 days. On a customer-initiated deletion (API or support ticket) we run an automated deletion workflow that: (a) removes records from the primary datastore and index; (b) invalidates and purges KV cache keys as applicable; (c) triggers async deletion from search indexes and downstream analytics within 24 hours; and (d) marks the record as removed in the backup index. End-to-end removal from all live systems is typically completed within 48 hours. Backup and snapshot removal is covered below.

3) Backups & snapshots: Backups are encrypted at rest (customer-managed KMS optional) and retained for a default of 90 days. During the backup retention window deleted records may exist inside backup slices. We provide a documented retention/playbook for expedited backup destruction for customers with contractual needs (e.g., 30-day backup retention) — execution time depends on the backup provider and can take up to 7 business days after a verified deletion request.

4) Evidence: attaching SOC 2 Type II summary and the deletion runbook. If anything in the runbook needs clarification, say the word and we'll walk through the playbook step-by-step.

Short next steps: we'll attach the SOC report and retention_playbook.md and confirm timelines for removing backups if you need an aggressive SLA.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: soc2-type2-2027.pdf (PDF), retention_playbook.md (Markdown)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-06-20T10:07:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pinebrook security questionnaire: hosted API data residency & retention — proposed language

Jonas / Marissa — forwarding Elena's questions. Drafted suggested language below for the official reply and for the retention_playbook.md entry. Please review/edit: 

--- suggested insertion for questionnaire response ---
Data residency (hosted API – US region): Customer request/response payloads and primary logs are persisted only in US-based cloud regions selected at account creation. System-level telemetry that does not contain request payloads may be aggregated centrally for platform health; such telemetry is stripped of identifiers prior to export.

Retention & deletion: Default retention for request logs is 90 days and is configurable via account settings. For customer-initiated erasure requests, Redwood executes an automated workflow: immediate deletion from the primary datastore and index, KV cache invalidation, index update, and a background reconciliation job that removes remnants from downstream services within 48 hours. Backup snapshots are on a 90-day lifecycle; certified expedited destruction can be executed within 7 business days upon contract or approved support ticket.

Backups & encryption: Backups are AES-256 encrypted at rest. Customers may opt to use a customer-managed KMS key for additional control.

--- end suggested text ---

Marissa: can you confirm the 48-hour and 7-business-day numbers are OK to include and whether we need to caveat "dependent on backup provider"? Also attaching the SOC 2 Type II full PDF for Elena (redacted summary is fine for the initial exchange).

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: soc2-type2-2027.pdf (PDF)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for your patience. Per internal ops and legal review (summary below) we confirm and provide attachments: the SOC 2 Type II report and our retention playbook are attached to this reply (see attachment stubs). Below are the final answers you can include in your internal report. Let us know if you want a short call to walk through the playbook.

Final answers (copyable):
- Data residency: For accounts configured for the US region, customer request/response payloads, generated outputs, and primary request logs are retained only in US-based cloud regions. No cross-region replication of request/response data occurs for hosted API customers unless explicitly enabled by the customer for multi-region redundancy.
- Retention & deletion: Default request-log retention is 90 days (configurable). Customer-initiated deletion triggers an automated erasure workflow that removes data from live systems within 48 hours. Removal from backup artifacts follows an expedited destruction schedule that can be executed within 7 business days upon request or contract provision; standard backup lifecycle is 90 days.
- Backups & encryption: All backups are encrypted at rest (AES-256); customers may opt for customer-managed KMS keys.
- Evidence: Attached: soc2-type2-2027.pdf, retention_playbook.md, and the original questionnaire (pinebrook_questionnaire_v2.xlsx).

If you require tighter timelines for backup destruction we can discuss a contract amendment or a custom operational commitment.

Best regards,
